procedure: After the supervisor merges and deploys, record exact hosted manifest SHA, service versions, switch time, and the next full UTC day D. Source/local validation does not satisfy hosted acceptance.

Read the existing ledger with mode=ro and PRAGMA query_only=ON: SELECT day,n AS calls,n-compile_calls AS extraction_calls,compile_calls,sources AS distinct_sources,CASE WHEN sources>0 THEN 1.0*(n-compile_calls)/sources END AS extraction_calls_per_source FROM calls WHERE day=:D. Require extraction_calls_per_source <=1.5.

For [D,D+1), count card-step paid answers only: events outcomes card/no_hypothesis/rejected written by HypothesisExtractor._answered. Restrict source_id to distinct news sources from the read-only owner outbox (deduplicate versions; do not multiply the event count through a join). Report answers, distinct news sources and answers/source, target <=1.2. Do not count compiler answers or ambiguous shared event outcomes.

Read-only acceptance/probes/discovery-pipeline against the deployed BFF during day D, and retain its hypothesis_cards values (calls_today, compile_calls, distinct_sources, calls_per_source, extraction_calls_per_source, calls_per_source_basis=extraction). Retain the completed daily ledger row after D closes. If the live probe is taken after UTC rollover, its live values describe the next day and must not be substituted for the completed D row.
